title: RL Post-Training Diffusion Language Models Along Their Own Generation Paths
abstract: arXiv:2610.17266v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models are a promising and more efficient alternative to autoregressive models. However, most RL post-training techniques are not easily adapted to these models. One issue is that diffusion language models generate answers through many intermediate states, deciding at each step which masked positions to reveal and which tokens to place in them. Many existing RL methods used in this setting approximate intractable sequence likelihoods or weight every denoising step by the same advantage, without explicitly distinguishing how these intermediate states of the denoising trajectory affect the expected reward. To address this issue of trajectory blindness, we introduce PACT (Potential-Anchored Consistency of Transitions). Motivated by a reward-tilted reference distribution, PACT jointly learns the policy and a scalar potential that scores each intermediate state, anchored by terminal reward. translated_title: 沿扩散语言模型自身的生成路径进行强化学习后训练
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型是自回归模型的一种有前景且更高效的替代方案。然而，大多数强化学习后训练技术并不容易适配这类模型。一个问题是，扩散语言模型通过许多中间状态生成答案，在每一步决定揭示哪些被掩码的位置以及在这些位置放置哪些词元。许多现有在此场景下使用的强化学习方法要么近似难以精确计算的序列似然，要么用相同的优势对所有去噪步骤进行加权，而没有明确区分去噪轨迹中的各个中间状态如何影响期望奖励。为了解决这种“轨迹盲视”问题，我们引入了PACT（Potential-Anchored Consistency of Transitions，势函数锚定的转移一致性方法）。受奖励倾斜参考分布的启发，PACT联合学习策略和一个标量势函数，该势函数为每个中间状态打分，并以终端奖励为锚。对于每个采样的去噪转移……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PACT方法，通过联合学习策略和一个以终端奖励为锚的标量势函数来为去噪轨迹中的每个中间状态打分，从而解决了现有强化学习方法在扩散语言模型后训练中对中间状态的“轨迹盲视”问题。
en_tdlr: PACT addresses trajectory blindness in RL post-training of diffusion language models by jointly learning the policy and a scalar potential that scores each intermediate denoising state, anchored by terminal reward.
